senses.gloss:
पर्य्-अय, अस्, m. revolution (of time), passing
away, lapse, expiration (e. g. काल-पर्ययात्, after
the lapse of a certain time); waste or loss (of time);
change, mutation, alteration [cf. वास-प्˚]; inver-
sion, irregular or inverted order, confusion; con-
trariety, opposition; deviation from enjoined or
customary observances, neglect of duty.

पर्यय पर्य्-अय, पर्य्-अयण. See under
परी, p. 551, col. 3.

पर्य्-आय, अस्, m. going or turning round, revolv-
ing, winding round; revolution, passing away (of
time), course, lapse, expiration; regular recurrence,
repetition; succession, turn; regular order, arrange-
ment, methodical disposition, method; a regularly
recurring series or formula, especially in the Ati-rātra
ceremony (Ved.); a strophe or clause of a hymn
(Ved.); a convertible term, synonym; a list of
synonyms; N. of a particular figure in rhetoric;
way, manner, mode, method of proceeding (e. g.
अनेन पर्यायेण, in this manner); property,
quality, generic or specific character; opportunity,
occasion; formation, creation, manufacture, prepara-
tion, artificial production; comprehensiveness, ag-
gregation; पर्यायेण, in succession, in turn, by
turns, by rotation, successively, alternately, (opposed
to युग-पत्.)
—पर्याय-क्रम, अस्, m. order of
[]
succession, regular rotation or turn.
—पर्याय-
च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has lost his turn, su-
perseded, supplanted.
—पर्याय-रत्न-माला, f.
‘pearl-string of synonyms,’ N. of a lexicon.
—पर्-
याय-वचन, अम्, n. a convertible term, synonym.
—पर्याय-वाचक, अस्, आ, अम्, expressing a cor-
responding notion.
—पर्याय-वृत्ति, इस्, f. alternate
course or action.
—पर्याय-शब्द, अस्, m. a con-
vertible term, synonym.
—पर्याय-शयन, अम्,
n. alternate sleeping and watching.
—पर्याय-शस्,
ind. by phrases or sentences, &c. (Ved.); periodically;
in succession, by rotation, by turns, seriatim.
—पर्-
यायान्न (˚य-अन्˚), अम्, n. food intended for an-
other, food that should have been given to some one
else (as that of a Śūdra to a Brāhman).
—पर्या-
यार्णव (˚य-अर्˚), अस्, m. ‘ocean of synonyms,’ N.
of a lexicon.
—पर्यायोक्त (˚य-उक्˚), अम्, n., N.
of a particular figure in rhetoric.
पर्याय पर्य्-आय. See under परी, p. 551.

पर्य्-अयण, अम्, n. going round, walking round,
circumambulating, roving about; anything wound
round (an arrow or other object); a horse's saddle or
housings.
पर्यायिक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. composed in strophes.
पर्यक् पर्य्-अक्. See 2. पर्य्-अञ्च् below.

पर्यगु पर्य्-अगु in comp. with पारम-
हंस्य, Bhāgavata-Purāṇa IV. 21, 40; according to
a Scholiast = परितो न गच्छन्ति गावो यस्मात्, but
variously taken, see पारमहंस्य-परि.

पर्यग्नि पर्य्-अग्नि, इस्, m., Ved. circumam-
bient fire; a torch carried round the sacrificial
animal; the ceremony of carrying fire round the
sacrificial animal; पर्यग्नि कृ, to carry fire round
any one (with acc.).

पर्यग्नि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. encircled with
fire.

पर्यग्नि-क्रियमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being
encircled with fire; (ए), loc. during the encircling
with fire.
पर्यङ्क पर्य्-अङ्क. See under 1. पर्य्-अञ्च्.

पर्य्-अङ्क, अस्, m. (fr. परि + अङ्क or perhaps
directly fr. 1. पर्य्-अञ्च् above; also spelt पल्य्-अङ्क),
a bed, couch, sofa; a litter, palanquin; a cloth thrown
over the back, loins and knees while seated on the
hams in the Oriental manner; sitting upon the hams
(a particular posture especially practised by ascetics in
meditation); N. of a mountain (son of Vindhya).
—पर्यङ्क-ग्रन्थि-बन्ध, अस्, m. or -˚बन्-
धन, अम्, n. the bending of the legs in sitting on
the hams.
—पर्यङ्क-बन्ध, अस्, m. sitting in
the Paryaṅka posture (= वीरासन).
—पर्यङ्क-
बन्धन, अम्, n. binding a cloth round the back,
loins and knees while squatting on the hams.
—पर्य्-
अङ्क-भोगिन्, ई, m. ‘couch-serpent,’ a kind of ser-
pent.
—पर्यङ्क-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, sitting on a sofa.

पर्यङ्ख् पर्य्-अङ्ख्, cl. 10. P. A. -अङ्खयति,
-ते, -यितुम्, Ved. to surround, clasp or encircle round.

पर्यङ्ग्य पर्यङ्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. परि +
अङ्ग), Ved. being about or at the side.

पर्यञ्च् 1. पर्य्-अञ्च् or पर्य्-अच्, cl. 1. P. A.
-अञ्चति, -ते, -अञ्चितुम्, Ved. to turn round, revolve.

2. पर्य्-अञ्च्, apparently only used in acc. sing.
neut. पर्य्-अक्, ind. round about, all round, in every
direction.

पर्यट् पर्य्-अट्, cl. 1. P. A. -अटति, -ते, -अटि-
तुम्, to roam or wander about, rove about.
पर्य्-अट, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

पर्य्-अटन, अम्, n. wandering about, peregrina-
tion, roaming through.
पर्य्-अटित, अम्, n. wandering about.

पर्यनुबन्ध पर्य्-अनुबन्ध, अस्, m. binding
round.

पर्यनुयोग पर्य्-अनुयोग, अस्, m. asking,
inquiring, question; blame, censure, reproach; con-
testing, disputing (?).

पर्यन्त पर्य्-अन्त, अस्, m. an encircling
boundary, circuit, circumference; limit, edge, skirt,
border, verge, extremity; end, termination, close
(e. g. काल-पर्यन्त, the end or close of an ap-
pointed time; पर्यन्तात् पर्यन्तम्, from one
end to the other); (अस्, आ, अम्), bounded, sur-
rounded by a boundary; extending in all directions;
(often at the end of comps., e. g. क्षुर-पर्य्-
अन्तं चक्रम्, a discus with edges like a razor's;
समुद्र-पर्यन्ता पृथिवी, the ocean-bounded
earth or the earth extending to the ocean.)
—पर्य्-
अन्त-देश, अस्, m. a neighbouring or adjacent dis-
trict.
—पर्यन्त-पर्यन्तम्, ind. to the end of,
as far as.
—पर्यन्त-पर्वत, अस्, m. an adjoining
hill.
—पर्यन्त-भू, ऊस्, f. ground contiguous to
the skirts of a river or mountain.
—पर्यन्त-स्थ,
अस्, आ, अम्, limitative, confining, adjoining, neighbour-
ing.
—पर्यन्त-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, bounding, con-
fining.
पर्यन्तिका, f. loss of all good qualities, depravity.

पार्यन्तिक पार्यन्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पर्य्-
अन्त), final, concluding, last.

पर्यन्य पर्यन्य, incorrectly for पर्जन्य,
q. v.

पर्यन्विष् पर्य्-अन्व्-इष्, cl. 6. P. -इच्छति,
-एष्टुम्, -एषितुम्, to seek for, search after.

पर्यर्षण पर्य्-अर्षण. See under 2. पर्य्-
ऋष्, p. 555, col. 3.

पर्य्-अर्षण, अम्, n., Ved. clasping round, sup-
porting, making firm.

पर्यवकॄ पर्य्-अव-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -क-
रितुम्, -करीतुम्, to scatter round or about, shed
over.

पर्यवच्छिद् पर्य्-अव-च्छिद् (˚छिद्), cl. 7. P.
A. -च्छिनत्ति, -च्छिन्त्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, Ved. to cut off
on both sides or all round.

पर्यवदात पर्य्-अवदात, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt.
दै or 7. दा with पर्य्-अव), perfectly clean or
pure; [cf. 7. दा, अव-दात.]

पर्यवदो पर्य्-अव-दो or पर्य्-अवदा (see rt.
3. दा), cl. 2. 4. P. -दाति, -द्यति, -दातुम्, Ved. to
cut off or slice all round.

पर्यवधारण पर्य्-अवधारण, अम्, n. pre-
cise determination, refining, subtilizing.

पर्यवरोध पर्य्-अवरोध, अस्, m. (fr. rt.
रुध् with पर्य्-अव), obstruction, hindrance.

पर्यवशेष पर्य्-अवशेष, अस्, m. end, ter-
mination.

पर्य्-अवशेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, regarded as the end
of all (i. e. God).

पर्यवष्टम्भ् पर्य्-अव-ष्टम्भ्, cl. 5. 9. P., 1.
A. -ष्टभ्नोति, -नाति, -ष्टम्भते, -ष्टम्भितुम्,
to surround; to surround with a view to obstruct.

पर्य्-अवष्टब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, in-
vested.

पर्य्-अवष्टम्भन, अम्, n. surrounding, in-
vesting.

पर्यवसो पर्य्-अव-सो, cl. 4. P. -स्यति, -सा-
तुम्, to finish, complete, conclude; to endeavour.

पर्य्-अवसान, अम्, n. end, termination, con-
clusion, issue.

पर्यवसानिक, अस्, आ, अम्, coming to a close,
drawing to an end or conclusion.

पर्य्-अवसायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, closing or ending with
(often in comps.).
—पर्यवसायि-त्व, अम्, n. ter-
mination, close.

पर्य्-अवसित, अस्, आ, अम्, finished, completed,
ended, terminated, concluded; perished, lost; re-
solved; लोकान्तरम् पर्य्-अवसितः, gone to another
world.

पर्यवस्कन्द पर्य्-अवस्कन्द, अस्, m. jumping
or leaping down (from a carriage).

पर्यवस्था 1. पर्य्-अव-स्था, cl. 1. P. A.
-तिष्ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, to be present or exist
everywhere; to rely upon: Caus. -स्थापयति,
-यितुम्, to raise, rouse.

2. पर्य्-अवस्था, f. or पर्य्-अवस्थान, अम्, n.
opposition, resistance, contradiction.

पर्य्-अवस्थातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, opposing, obstruct-
ing, opposed to or against; (ता), m. an antagonist,
opponent, adversary, enemy.

पर्य्-अवस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed to, siding
with an enemy.

पर्यवे पर्य्-अवे (पर्य्-अव-इ, see rt. 5. इ),
cl. 2. P. -अवैति, -अवैतुम्, Ved. to turn round,
turn in the right direction; to pass, elapse.

पर्यवेक्ष् पर्य्-अवेक्ष् (पर्य्-अव-ईक्ष्), cl. 1.
A. -अवेक्षते, -क्षितुम्, to regard from every side,
regard (?).

पर्यश् 1. पर्य्-अश्, cl. 5. P. A. -अश्नोति, -नुते,
अशितुम्, Ved. to arrive at, reach, attain (Sāy. =
परितो व्य्-आप्).

पर्यश् 2. पर्य्-अश्, cl. 9. P. -अश्नाति, -अशितुम्,
to eat.

पर्यस् 2. पर्य्-अस्, cl. 4. P. A. -अस्यति, -ते,
-असितुम्, to throw or cast round, put or place round,
put on, spread round, diffuse; to surround, encircle,
encompass; to enchase; to entrap, ensnare; to turn
round, turn over; to turn away; to throw down,
overturn, upset: Pass. -अस्यते, to fall down, drop,
sink down: Caus. to cause to drop, to cause to roll
down or shed (as tears).

पर्यास् पर्य्-आस्, cl. 2. A. -आस्ते, -आसितुम्, to
sit round any one (acc.); to remain sitting, remain
inactive; to exclude one's self from (with acc.).

पर्यश्रु पर्य्-अश्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, bathed in or
suffused with tears, shedding tears, tearful.

पर्य्-असन, अम्, n. throwing about, moving to
and fro, wagging; casting, sending; putting off or
away.
पर्य्-आसन, अम्, n. revolution, circumvolution.

पर्य्-अस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or cast round,
placed round, put on, diffused; surrounded, encom-
passed, ensnared; thrown off, thrown down; thrown
or tossed up; overturned, upset; dismissed, laid aside;
struck, killed; bound.
—पर्यस्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. containing the notion expressed by the word
पर्य्-अस्त.
—पर्यस्त-विलोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, or
पर्यस्ताक्ष (˚त-अक्ष), अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. having
the eyes cast or directed round.

पर्य्-अस्ति, इस्, f. sitting upon the hams (= पर्य्-
अङ्क, q. v.).
पर्यस्तिका, f. = पर्य्-अस्ति above.

पर्य्-अस्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, scattering; oversetting,
upsetting; investing.

पर्य्-आस, अस्, m. edging, trimming (Ved.); end.
conclusion; epithet of particular concluding strophes
in certain hymns (Ved.); rotation, revolution; in-
verted order or position.

पर्यास पर्य्-आस, पर्य्-आसन. See under
2. पर्य्-अस्, p. 554, col. 3.
पर्य्-आसित, अस्, आ, अम्, upset, subverted, reversed.

पर्यस्तमयम् पर्य्-अस्तमयम्, ind., Ved.
about sunset.

पर्याकुल पर्य्-आकुल, अस्, आ, अम्, filled, full;
turbid on all sides (as water), turbid; confounded,
confused, disordered, beside one's self, excited, agi-
tated, anxious, bewildered, infatuated.
—पर्याकुल-
त्व, अम्, n. confusion, bewilderment.

पर्याकृ पर्य्-आ-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति,
-कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, Ved. to turn round.

पर्याक्षिप् पर्य्-आ-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षि-
पति, -ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to wind round, turn.

पर्यागम् पर्य्-आ-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति,
-गन्तुम्, to go round, perform a revolution, elapse;
to last or live through a space of time; to come to
an end or conclusion; to surround on every side,
encircle, ensnare, get into one's power.

पर्य्-आगत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has finished
the course or career of life.

पर्यागल् पर्य्-आ-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, -ग-
लितुम्, to let fall in drops, drop, trickle.

पर्य्-आगलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dropping, falling,
trickling.

पर्यागा पर्य्-आ-गा (occurring in Aor. पर्य्-
आगात्, Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 8157), to perform a revo-
lution, elapse.

पर्याचर् पर्य्-आ-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -च-
रितुम्, Ved. to come near, approach, resort to.

पर्याचान्त पर्य्-आचान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sipped,
rinsed prematurely; (scil. अन्नम्) food left by a
person who has rinsed his mouth out.

पर्याण पर्याण, अम्, n. (for परि-याण), a
circuit (Ved.); a saddle, pack-saddle or cloth serving
for one.

पर्याणह् पर्य्-आ-णह्, cl. 4. P. A. -णह्यति,
-ते, -णद्धुम्, Ved. to cover up, cover.
पर्य्-आणहन, अम्, n., Ved. a covering.

पर्याणी पर्य्-आ-णी, cl. 1. P. A. -णयति, -ते,
-णेतुम्, to lead round; to lead or bring forward.

पर्यातन् पर्य्-आ-तन्, cl. 5. P. A. -तनोति,
-नुते, -तनितुम्, Ved. to spread round, encompass,
surround.

पर्यादा पर्य्-आ-दा, cl. 3. A. -दत्ते, -दातुम्,
to make one's own, appropriate, learn; to take pos-
session of; to take anything (acc.) away from (abl.);
to take off, remove; to seize, grasp.

पर्याद्रु पर्य्-आ-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रो-
तुम्, to run to and fro, hasten round about.

पर्याधा पर्य्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति,
-धत्ते, -धातुम्, Ved. to lay round, surround
with (fire).

पर्याप् पर्य्-आप्, cl. 5. P. -आप्नोति, -आप्तुम्,
to reach, obtain, gain (Ved.); to make an end of;
to be content: Desid. परीप्सति, &c., to wish to
obtain or reach; to try to get at; to ask for, request,
desire; to wish to preserve, guard; to lie in wait
or ambush.

पर्य्-आप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained, gained; finished,
ended, completed, complete, large, extensive, spacious;
full; able, adequate, enough, sufficient; many;
(अम्), ind. willingly, readily; ably, powerfully; satis-
factorily.
—पर्याप्त-कल, अस्, आ, अम्, having full
digits (as the moon).
—पर्याप्त-काम, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. one whose desires are under control.
—पर्याप्-
त-ता, f. satisfaction, gratification.
—पर्याप्त-दक्-
षिण, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied with liberal gifts.
—पर्याप्त-भोग, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing or en-
joying a sufficiency.
—पर्याप्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
able, capable.

पर्यापत् पर्य्-आ-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -प-
तितुम्, to hasten forth, hurry away, run away.

पर्याप्लु पर्य्-आ-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लो-
तुम्, to run round, encompass, encircle: Caus. -प्ला-
वयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to cause to float round.
पर्य्-आप्लाव, अस्, m. revolution.
पर्य्-आप्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, encircled.

पर्याभू पर्य्-आ-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भ-
वितुम्, Ved. to turn round.

पर्याभृ पर्य्-आ-भृ, cl. 1. P. -भरति, -भर्-
तुम्, Ved. to extract.
पर्य्-आ-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. extracted.

पर्यामृश् पर्य्-आ-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृशति,
-मर्ष्टुम्, -म्रष्टुम्, to subdue, conquer, over-
power.

पर्यारिन् पर्य्-आरिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. rt. 4. ऋ with
परि), Ved. (perhaps) falling away, decaying, decrepit.

पर्यालोच् पर्य्-आ-लोच्, cl. 10. P. -लोचयति,
-यितुम्, to look after, attend to, consider (the in-
terests of another), ponder.

पर्य्-आलोचन, अम्, n. or पर्य्-आलोचना, f. look-
ing round or about; circumspection, attentive observa-
tion, mature consideration or reflection, deliberating;
knowing, recognising.

पर्याविल पर्य्-आविल, अस्, आ, अम्, very turbid,
much soiled.

पर्यावृत् पर्य्-आ-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते,
-वर्तितुम्, to turn round, return: Caus. P. -वर्त-
यति, -यितुम्, to roll round, turn round: Desid.
-विवृत्सति, Ved. to wish to roll round.
पर्य्-आवर्त, अस्, m. return.

पर्य्-आवर्तन, अस्, m., N. of a hell; (अम्), n.
coming back, returning.

पर्य्-आवर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, sub-
verted, reversed.

पर्य्-आविवृत्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. wishing to
roll round.

पर्याश्वस् पर्य्-आ-श्वस्, Caus. P. -श्वासयति,
-यितुम्, to comfort, console.

पर्याहार पर्य्-आहार, अस्, m. a yoke worn
across the shoulders in carrying a load; conveying,
taking; a load; storing hay or grain; a ewer,
pitcher.
पर्युक पर्युक, अस्, m., N. of a man.

पर्युक्ष् पर्य्-उक्ष्, cl. 6. P. -उक्षति, -उक्षि-
तुम्, Ved. to sprinkle round.

पर्य्-उक्षण, अम्, n. sprinkling round; sprink-
ling; (ई), f. a vessel for sprinkling (Ved.).

पर्युत्थान पर्य्-उत्थान, अम्, n. standing
up, rising.

पर्युत्सुक पर्य्-उत्सुक, अस्, आ, अम्, afficted,
sad, sorrowful, regretting; eagerly desirous, longing
for (with dat.).
पर्युदञ्चन पर्य्-उदञ्चन, अम्, n. debt.

पर्युदयम् पर्य्-उदयम्, ind., Ved. about
sunrise.

पर्युदस् पर्य्-उद्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असि-
तुम्, to heap round about, to construct here and
there; to prohibit, object to; to expect, exclude.

पर्य्-उदस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped round; prohibited,
objected to (as a ceremony); excepted, excluded.

पर्य्-उदास, अस्, m. or पर्य्-उदासन, अम्, n.
a prohibitive rule or precept, exception.

पर्युद्भृत पर्य्-उद्भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
brought out, extracted; constructed, framed.

पर्युद्विज् पर्य्-उद्-विज्, cl. 7. P. -विनक्ति,
-विजितुम्, to suffer pain, suffer.

पर्युपवेशन पर्य्-उपवेशन, अम्, n. sitting
about.

पर्य्-उपस्थान, अम्, n. waiting upon, serving,
maintaining; rising, elevation.

पर्य्-उपस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, drawing nigh, immi-
nent, impending.

पर्युपस्पृश् पर्य्-उप-स्पृश्, cl. 6. P. -स्पृ-
शति, -स्प्रष्टुम्, -स्पर्ष्टुम्, to touch or use for
ablution or bathing.

पर्युपास् पर्य्-उपास् (पर्य्-उप-आस्), cl. 2. A.
-आस्ते, -आसितुम्, to sit round, surround, encompass,
encircle; to sit on or upon; to live around; to be
present at, partake of; to approach as an attendant
or worshipper, show reverence, worship.

पर्य्-उपासक, अस्, आ, अम्, worshipping, honouring,
a worshipper, one who honours or respects.

पर्य्-उपासन, अम्, n. encamping or sitting
round; friendliness, amiability, courtesy; honour,
service, worship; joining in or concurrence with any
act of reverence.

पर्य्-उपासितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, moving round or
about; showing respect or honour; a worshipper.
पर्य्-उपासीन, अस्, आ, अम्, seated or sitting upon.

पर्युप्त पर्य्-उप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वप् with
परि), sown; set (as a gem in a ring).
पर्य्-उप्ति, इस्, f. scattering seed, sowing.

पर्युषण पर्य्-उषण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 6. वस्
with परि or incorrectly for पर्य्-एषण), service,
worship, adoration.

पर्य्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम्, having passed the night;
stale, not fresh; insipid; stupid, vain.
—पर्युषित-
भोजिन्, ई, m. the eater of stale food (said to become
a maggot or worm in the next birth).

पर्यूह् पर्य्-ऊह् [cf. rt. 1. ऊह्], cl. 1. P. A.
-ऊहति, -ते, -ऊहितुम्, Ved. to heap or pile round; to
surround or fortify with mounds or embankments.

पर्य्-ऊहण, अम्, n., Ved. sweeping or heaping
together.

पर्यृष् 1. पर्य्-ऋष्, cl. 1. P. -अर्षति, -अर्-
षितुम्, Ved. to flow round, flow into.

पर्यृष् 2. पर्य्-ऋष्, cl. 6. P. -ऋषति, -अर्षि-
तुम्, Ved. to embrace, clasp round, support.

पर्ये पर्य्-ए (परि-आ-इ), cl. 2. P. -एति, -एतुम्,
Ved. to roam about; to come back, return.

पर्येतृ पर्य्-एतृ, ता, त्री, तृ (fr. परी), Ved.
overpowering, mastering; (Sāy.) = नाशक, a de-
spoiler; = परि-गमयितृ, a promoter.

पर्येष् पर्य्-एष्, cl. 1. P. -एषति, -एषितुम्,
to seek about for.
पर्य्-एषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, seeking about for.

पर्य्-एष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sought after, to
be sought.
पर्य्-एष्टि, इस्, f. searching for, inquiry.

पार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being on the opposite
side or bank; upper; last, final; giving the last
stroke, decisive (e. g. पार्ये धने, Ved. in a decisive
battle); causing to succeed, helping through; effec-
tual, efficient; (अम्), n. end; decision.
पार्य पार्य. See p. 566, col. 3.
